comment: Node.js is a PREREQUISITE of the desktop app (>= minimumMajor, installed by the user). This pin is only used by prepare-bundle -IncludeNode, which bundles node.exe for a portable/full build, and documents the version the app is tested with. Update version + file + sha256 together (from https://nodejs.org/dist/v<version>/SHASUMS256.txt).
